text: I can classify a lock as efficiency or correctness and say what each failure costs, and when a CAS write or single owner removes the need for a lock.
I can explain why a lease can expire while its holder still believes it holds the lock, and size a TTL and renewal interval.
I can draw the GC-pause timeline with and without fencing tokens and say exactly what fencing does and does not guarantee.
I can write a correct single-node Redis lock with token-checked release and explain how failover loses it.
I can summarise both sides of the Redlock debate fairly in a few sentences each.
I can describe the ZooKeeper ephemeral-sequential lock recipe and etcd's lease-based lock, and name the fencing token each provides.
